description: After hold_pay and the payer's signature: the header the merchant reads (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE, or X-PAYMENT for x402 version 1), base64 JSON with the voucher { hold, cumulative, signature }. Reads no chain and sends nothing; recovers a 65-byte signature to the hold's payer. Send the same request again with header.name set to header.value.

payment_required.description: The same payment_required given to hold_pay

signature.description: The payer's signature of hold_pay's typed_data (0x hex)

voucher.description: The voucher hold_pay returned, as it returned it

name: hold_header
title: The x402 payment header for a signed voucher
